carbon_accounting.inventory_carbon: Three-hour endpoint-mean stocks integrated over 224 intervals (672 hours); 225 states with half weight at initial and terminal boundaries; SAF kg converted to tonnes and H2 retained in kg
carbon_accounting.inventory_cost: Keep the model site-peak/2 proxy and its optimized cost components; do not apply a second time multiplier
carbon_accounting.electricity_ci_rule: Configured grid electricity intensity at every DAC-BH location
carbon_accounting.coal_and_synthesis: For CTL scenarios, reconstruct coal emissions from actual purchased coal and synthesis emissions from configured technology energy at each production site
carbon_accounting.ccu_dac_synthesis: CCU and DAC FT/MTJ use the common configured route-level input assumption of 7.6 kWh/kg final fuel for physical demand, electricity cost and emissions; no additional methanol-stage electricity is added
carbon_accounting.meoh_co2_stock_energy: No separate energy coefficients in the model; no new coefficients inserted
carbon_accounting.carbon_categories: Original eight categories with aggregate transport aliases removed; utilization credit separate
